mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id AS userId, m.user_name AS userName, m.email AS email, m.created_at AS createdAt, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board b WHERE b.user_id = m.user_id ) AS boardCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board_reply r WHERE r.user_id = m.user_id ) AS replyCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board_like l WHERE l.user_id = m.user_id ) AS likeCount FROM members m ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.user_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.idx, b.title, b.created_at as createdAt, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board_like l WHERE l.board_idx = b.idx ) AS likeCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board_reply r WHERE r.board_idx = b.idx ) AS replyCount FROM tb_board b WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.idx DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.reply_idx AS replyIdx, r.board_idx AS boardIdx, b.title AS boardTitle, r.content, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM tb_board_reply r JOIN tb_board b ON b.idx = r.board_idx WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.reply_idx DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT m.user_id AS userId, m.user_name AS userName, m.email AS email, m.created_at AS createdAt, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board b WHERE b.user_id = m.user_id ) AS boardCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board_like l WHERE l.user_id = m.user_id ) AS likeCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board_reply r WHERE r.user_id = m.user_id ) AS replyCount FROM members m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId}
